sources.title: Retreat cost removal priority FAQ
sources.supports: An effect removing all retreat Energy takes priority over numerical increases.

sources.title: Official effect calculation guide
sources.supports: Cost removal supersedes increases and reductions; merely reducing cost remains numerical.

sources.title: Silvally-GX Gyro Unit
sources.supports: While in play, grants own Basic Pokemon no Retreat Cost.

sources.title: Salamence-GX Dragon Float
sources.supports: Own Pokemon have no Retreat Cost except GX and legacy EX; modern ex is a separate category.

sources.title: Dragonite Jet Cruise
sources.supports: All own Pokemon have no Retreat Cost while the source is in play.

sources.title: Morpeko In a Hungry Hurry
sources.supports: Free retreat while no Energy cards are attached.

sources.title: Alolan Raichu Surfer
sources.supports: Any Stadium in play enables this Pokemon's free retreat.

sources.title: Golisopod Emergency Exit
sources.supports: At most two attached Energy units enables free retreat.

sources.title: Zeraora-GX Thunderclap Zone
sources.supports: Own Pokemon with Lightning Energy attached have no Retreat Cost.

sources.title: Froakie Frubbles
sources.supports: Attached qualifying Energy enables self free retreat; the required Water type is retained from local original English sprite text.

sources.title: Archaludon Metal Bridge
sources.supports: Own Pokemon with qualifying attached Energy have no Retreat Cost; Metal type is retained from local original English sprite text.

sources.title: Sudowoodo Vamoose
sources.supports: Any damage counter on the Pokemon enables free retreat.

sources.title: Absol Dark Ambition
sources.supports: Increase opposing Active Basic Pokemon Retreat Cost by one.

sources.title: Air Balloon
sources.supports: Reduce attached Pokemon Retreat Cost by two.

sources.title: Rescue Board
sources.supports: Reduce Retreat Cost by one; at remaining HP thirty or lower, remove the entire cost.

sources.title: Mount Lanakila
sources.supports: Increase each Basic Pokemon Retreat Cost on both fields by one.

sources.title: Fairy Garden
sources.supports: Free retreat for qualifying attached Energy on either field; Fairy type comes from local original English sprite text.

sources.title: Basic retreat action rules
sources.supports: Retreat is an action subject to payment, available Bench and its own restrictions; a free cost does not waive those restrictions.

scope: 81 newly recognized components (66 abilities and 15 Trainers, including two already-handwritten Trainer printings), 68 fully supported additional cards.
boundaries: Only complete recognized clauses are mapped; unresolved components keep whole cards unsupported.
Free retreat removes the whole cost after increases; it does not permit retreat through Sleep, Paralysis, a retreat lock or the once-per-turn limit.
Any/no attached Energy checks physical cards; typed Energy and the two-Energy threshold read supplied units.
Stadium-in-play does not mean a player controls the Stadium; owner-specific wording remains unsupported.
Basic, GX and legacy EX eligibility remains exact; numerical modifiers and HP-based free-retreat overrides stay distinct.
Bilateral Stadiums query current recipients, and source removal or suppression takes effect immediately.
Future Booster Energy Capsule remains unsupported pending explicit Future-family metadata.
